pages.title: f-strings
pages.content: f-strings (formatted string literals) let you embed expressions inside strings. Prefix the string with `f` and put variables inside curly braces `{}`. This is the modern and preferred way to format strings.

pages.title: Using f-strings
pages.content: Embed variables directly in your strings:
pages.code:
name = "Alice"
age = 25

# f-string
print(f"My name is {name} and I am {age}.")

# Expressions inside braces
print(f"Next year I'll be {age + 1}.")

# Formatting numbers
price = 49.99
print(f"Total: ${price:.2f}")

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: What prefix creates an f-string?
pages.explanation: Place the letter f before the opening quote to create an f-string.
